provenance.rationale: Apparatus constants are intentionally NOT model results; this JSON exists solely so the number-provenance gate (verify_number_provenance.py v2.1) can resolve them via a legitimate JSON source rather than substring coincidence. Plan 14-14 restructure: the field name `apparatus_dimensions_mm` previously lumped the 880 nm IR LED wavelength with 6 cm tube OD, 120 cm tube length, and 10-minute logging interval under a single `_mm` label that misrepresented the units; the per-unit subfields are now `tube_outer_diameter_cm`, `tube_length_cm`, `data_logging_interval_min`, `ir_led_wavelength_nm` matching the LaTeX semantics at main.tex:176-180 exactly.
